name: cast-media-platform
description: CAST — Complete Media Casting & Streaming Platform. Created By Shiv Yogi.

scripts.serve: node -e 'const http=require("http"), fs=require("fs"), path=require("path"); http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let p=path.join(process.cwd(), req.url==="/"?"index.html":req.url.split("?")[0]); fs.readFile(p,(e,d)=>{ if(e){res.statusCode=404;res.end("Not found");}else{ const ext=path.extname(p); const m={".html":"text/html",".css":"text/css",".js":"text/javascript",".svg":"image/svg+xml",".json":"application/json"}; res.setHeader("Content-Type", m[ext]||"text/plain"); res.end(d); } }); }).listen(8080, ()=>console.log("CAST running at http://localhost:8080"));'

author: Shiv Yogi
